name: Truebit TRU bonding-curve purchase-price overflow
summary: The pre-0.8 Purchase implementation computed the TRU purchase price with unchecked arithmetic. Crafted buy amounts overflowed the price numerator so the ETH cost wrapped to near zero, letting the attacker mint vast TRU (Purchase holds TRU's minter role) and sell it back to the bonding curve, draining its ETH reserve in repeated buy-sell rounds.
notes: The proxy has run this implementation since its constructor; the age runs from the TRU grantRole that made Purchase a minter 14 blocks later (rule 10), without which the free buys could not mint.

Later cheap curve buys (0xc0454e54's ~71 ETH of DEX sales, c0ffeebabe's dust arbitrage) paid the correct price for a reserve the anchor had left at ~4 ETH; they arbitraged TRU's collapse in DEX pools without the overflow, so they are not campaign or loss.
